She also heard Donald’s response in scenario 3: he said it was okay, that he knew she meant well, and that it was “a lot to process.”

Gloria does not directly know Donald’s private internal state—whether he truly forgave her, whether he still resents her, or whether his earlier dissatisfaction is rooted in personal issues. She only has his verbal response and her interpretation of it. In scenario 4, she does not yet know the later outcome of the project from scenario 5.
